title: Safe Action Gate Preflight Schema
description: Required preflight object the Safe Action Gate must collect and display BEFORE rendering a confirm affordance for any executable tier (T0i, T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, T6). The schema is normative. Missing values render as the literal string 'UNKNOWN' and trigger fail-closed refusal: the gate refuses confirmation and routes to the Unknown/Drift Queue with the missing-field reason.
fail_closed_rule: If any required field on this preflight object resolves to 'UNKNOWN' for the assigned tier, the gate MUST NOT render a confirm affordance. The gate routes to the Unknown/Drift Queue with the missing-field reason (see SAFE_ACTION_REFUSAL_RULES.md). The gate never invents values, never silently substitutes defaults, and never auto-confirms.

command.description: Fully resolved invocation including subcommands. No shell-escape ambiguity. Verbatim from upstream payload.

resolved_params.description: Map of required and optional parameters with values resolved per PALETTE_PARAMETER_PREVIEW_SPEC.md. No required value may be 'UNKNOWN'. Optional defaults are explicit (was_default flag set).

required.description: Map of name → value. No value may be 'UNKNOWN'.

optional.description: Map of name → {value, was_default: bool}. Defaults are explicit; never implicit.

cwd.description: Absolute path within the current worktree. Never '/tmp' or any non-worktree path. The gate refuses if cwd is outside the worktree.

worktree_metadata.description: Runtime worktree info: branch, detached-state, dirty flag (when knowable). The gate refuses for tiers requiring clean state if dirty flag is set.

authority_domain.description: Authority domain that owns the action. The gate never substitutes its own authority. 'unknown / conflicting' fails closed.

canonical_writer.description: System or service that owns the write/state mutation for this row. If multiple writers exist, all writers are listed comma-separated. Required for the gate to display every writer for T2–T6 actions.

safety_class.description: Safety class governing the row's allowed UI form. Only CONFIRM_REQUIRED and COMMAND_PALETTE_ONLY (with executable tier) reach a confirm affordance.

gate_tier.description: Confirmation tier. Carried verbatim from upstream surface; the gate never reclassifies. Only T1–T6 reach a confirm affordance.

side_effects.description: Enumerated side effects. Must not be empty for any executable tier (T1–T6). Empty or 'UNKNOWN' fails closed for executable tiers.

expected_proof.description: Proof category the gate must capture. UNKNOWN fails closed for executable tiers (T1–T6).

rollback_or_abort.description: Explicit rollback path, abort token, or NOT_APPLICABLE with documented reason. Required for executable tiers; UNKNOWN fails closed for T3, T4, T5, T6 (and T2 with destructive scope).

source_provenance.description: End-to-end provenance preserved. Used for audit trail and operator inspection.

palette_request_id.description: UUID generated at upstream handoff. Correlation id for evidence/audit logs. The gate event/receipt records the same id.

palette_index_row_hash.description: SHA-256 of the normalized index row at handoff time. Lets the gate verify the row hasn't drifted in flight (INDEX_DRIFT detection). Stale hash fails closed.

surface_origin.source: Upstream surface that originated the action request
surface_origin.description: Which surface originated this gate invocation. Other origins (deep-link, URL parameter, keyboard shortcut bypassing the surface) are refused.

operator_intent.source: Upstream surface (operator's selected outcome at the surface)
operator_intent.description: What the operator intends. Required so the gate displays the action's purpose before confirmation. UNKNOWN fails closed for executable tiers.

created_at_utc.source: Generated at handoff time at upstream surface
created_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp recording when the upstream surface produced the action request. The gate uses this to detect stale handoffs.

preflight_invariants: Every required field for the row's tier MUST be present before the gate renders a confirm affordance.
Missing fields render as the literal string 'UNKNOWN', never blank.
The gate never invents values for missing fields and never silently substitutes defaults.
Optional parameter defaults are explicit (was_default: true); implicit defaults are forbidden.
cwd MUST be inside the current worktree; '/tmp' or non-worktree paths are refused.
authority_domain == 'unknown / conflicting' or canonical_writer == 'UNKNOWN' fails closed for any executable tier.
safety_class in {BLOCKED_IN_COCKPIT, UNKNOWN, EXTERNAL_ONLY} never reaches a confirm affordance.
palette_index_row_hash MUST match the live index hash at gate-open time; mismatch is INDEX_DRIFT and fails closed.
surface_origin MUST be one of the allowed origins; deep-links and bypass paths are refused.
